## Activity

During May 2019, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 81 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and reflects the volume submitted by the site for review. The activity figure should be considered alongside the image quality and grading outcomes set out below.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded during May 2019, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.5 per cent. This indicates that a small proportion of the submitted images could not be used for grading. The site should continue to monitor image quality and identify any recurring issues affecting capture quality.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during the month. The median grading wait was 5 days. These figures provide the summary grading position for Oakridge Primary Care for May 2019.

The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help maintain consistent image quality and grading activity at the site.
